mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5d returns in fewer than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the return distribution in triggered periods is not significantly different from the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1950 thousand units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to a higher probability of Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers a market expectation of policy easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the return distribution in triggered periods is not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment where the Fed maintains restrictive policy, leading to higher real rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust household demand and a strong economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the joint signal does not outperform individual proxies in a predictive regression (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction term is not significant in a predictive model (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 360,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 360,000, or the average return in high-RSAFS periods is not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
